title: Payment-Method Schedule for the Basis-Month Eligibility Credit
content:
**Schedule.** Under the payment-method schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the basis-month eligibility credit on a Pre-K tuition account has an amount added by the number of tuition payments the enrollment shows by personal check or money order in the school year.

| Tuition payments by personal check or money order on the enrollment in the school year | Added to the credit |
|---|---|
| two or more | 5.00 |
| exactly one | 2.50 |
| none | nothing |

Personal checks and money orders are counted together; online card and ACH bank draft payments are not counted.

## Examples (hypothetical enrollments)

- Two money orders and one online card payment this school year: two counted, 5.00 added.
- One personal check: 2.50 added.
- Only ACH bank drafts: nothing added.
